column4: SF YIMBY reports on June 3, 2022 that Mission Rock Partners has launched construction on China Basin Park with a groundbreaking ceremony (the article gives its publication date, not the ceremony's date)

235 Berry (Signature Development Group): SocketSite (Sept 26, 2006, headline 'Under 50% Sold?') noted that at least four of the six units released in June were still available and reported the developer was shooting for closings and occupancy by the end of 2006

Arterra (300 Berry St) reported topped off at 16 floors (SocketSite, July 30, 2007, citing Intracorp; a reader comment dates the topping-off party about a week earlier). Intracorp expected completion and closing of escrows in spring 2008

Avalon at Mission Bay Phase III (addressed as 240 Berry St in this coverage, which does not mention 353 King St; DBI new-construction permit 200105300277 for 353 King St also describes 17 stories and 260 dwellings) under way: SocketSite's post 'Starts Its Ascent' notes a construction webcam and flyers advertising 260 apartments, a 17-story tower and an 8-story mid-rise, coming mid-2009
Azure Apartments (690 Long Bridge St) topped out

Groundbreaking for the hotel then billed as 'Marriott SOMA Mission Bay' at 100 Channel St (became LUMA Hotel San Francisco), Mission Bay's first hotel project; Potrero View later wrote that the Marriott chain was never part of actual plans
Construction under way on 'Radiance West' (325 China Basin Phase Two), the site later completed as Madrone, after a 2008 suspension; SocketSite reported move-in expected by mid-2012
Park Terrace (325 Berry St) under construction, slated for completion by end of 2006

Kilroy Realty holds a groundbreaking ceremony for The Exchange on 16th (1800 Owens St) with Mayor Ed Lee (The Registry, September 4, 2015: 'launched its third San Francisco ground-up development project yesterday with a ground-breaking ceremony'); a ceremony, not proof that building work was under way: DataSF shows the new-construction permit (201409045458) issued November 12, 2015

SocketSite (post dated September 6, 2016) reports that pile drivers for Uber's Mission Bay headquarters (1455 & 1515 3rd St) 'have arrived and are being assembled' and that the permit paperwork to start driving the piles had been filed; the post date is a publication date, not a construction start, and DataSF shows the pile permit (201606039047) issued October 18, 2016 and the new-construction permit (201508245062) issued November 3, 2016

UC Board of Regents approves plans for the UCSF Bakar Ear & Hearing Institute for this block: a five-story, 150,000 sq ft building on Fifth Street at Nelson Rising Lane, with construction expected to begin in late 2026 and completion anticipated in 2029 (UCSF announcement, republished by Mirage News on May 7, 2026)

column4: Mortenson's news item of 11/20/2017 (publication date) reports structural steel work starting on the Chase Center development, which includes two office buildings (the page gives no street addresses; Pier & Point reads them as 1655 & 1725 3rd St). The 11/20/17 start is for the arena; the item's schedule has office-building steel running 2/27/2018 to 8/18/2018 and the project's 'topping out' (completion of all structural steel) on 9/1/2018 -- 6,000 tons of office-tower steel, fabricated by Gayle Manufacturing Co. and erected by Cal Erectors. The item is a schedule, and no report of the actual office-steel dates was read, so it does not date when the office towers went under construction
